org.title: Members & departments
org.entryHint: Reporting lines, departments and who can see which contracts.
org.lead: "By structure" mode: editors and viewers only see contracts they own, their reports' and their department's (as head). Owners see everything.
org.ownerOnly: A company admin is required to manage members and departments.
org.cycle: Not allowed: this person reports to them (management loop).
org.deptsMoved: Departments (add, parent, head, members) are edited in one place: the org chart in admin.
